sections.title: Operational verification: self-test
sections.setup: Power on and let the counter finish its power-on test.  The program sends *TST? (Programmer's Reference p. 201: 0 = all tests passed, 1 = at least one failed; it takes more than 5 seconds and the counter then does a Factory Reset).  The frequency checks (p. 33) and the termination checks (p. 35) print no numeric limit ("approximately 10 MHz", "approximately 50 ohm" / "1 Mohm") and need a DMM for the terminations: they are NOT built as pass / fail points.

sections.title: Test 1: Absolute time base
sections.setup: Source: 10 MHz, +7 dBm into Channel 1 (50 ohm), locked to the 10 MHz primary frequency standard (FS725 Rubidium, better than 1e-10).  The counter uses its INTERNAL time base.  Preset; trigger Manual; 100 readings per trigger; noise rejection Off; Ch1 DC coupling, 50 ohm, 5 V range, auto level Off, level 0.000 V, bandwidth limit Off, probe 1:1; statistics On.  Mean must be 10 MHz +/- 10 Hz (standard time base) or +/- 0.5 Hz (Option 010); half of that for a counter in operation more than 1 year.

flags: Limits for a counter in operation MORE than 1 year are half of the 1-year limits (footnotes [a] and [b], record p. 91; test text p. 43): both are built, the operator picks the period.
The limits assume the primary frequency standard (better than 1e-10) replaced the factory calibration uncertainty and a calibration at 23 +/- 5 C (p. 43).

sections.title: Test 2: Frequency accuracy, channels 1 and 2
sections.setup: Source: 10, 115 and 350 MHz at +7 dBm into Channel 1, then Channel 2 (the 53210A has no Channel 2).  The counter uses an EXTERNAL 10 MHz reference on Ext Ref In (the FS725 house standard).  Preset; Auto measurement mode; noise rejection Off; trigger Manual; 100 readings; gate Timed 10 ms, Gate Out On, polarity Normal; channel DC, 50 ohm, 5 V range, bandwidth limit Off, auto level Off, level 0.000 V; statistics On.  Mean and Std Dev are judged against the record-page limits.

sections.title: Test 3: Single period
sections.setup: Source: 1 MHz and 250 MHz at +7 dBm into Channel 1, then Channel 2.  External 10 MHz reference.  Time Interval, Single Period; auto level Off, level 0 V; noise rejection Off; channel DC, 50 ohm, 5 V range, bandwidth limit Off; trigger Manual, 100 readings, delay 0.  53220A and 53230A only.

sections.title: Test 4: Pulse width
sections.setup: Source: pulse generator (Keysight 81134A or equivalent) 1 Vpp, period 66.6 ns, pulse width 5 ns, into Channel 1 then Channel 2 (50 ohm).  External 10 MHz reference.  Pulse Width, width positive, auto level Off, level 0.00 V, noise rejection Off; channel DC, 50 ohm, 5 V range, bandwidth limit Off; trigger Manual, 100 readings.  53220A and 53230A only.  The 96270A has no pulse output: another standard is needed.

flags: UNVERIFIED: the Agilent 33250A cannot make the 5 ns pulse (minimum width 8 ns), so with it this test runs at 8 ns (owner decision 2026-10-27). The manual prints limits for 5 ns only: these are the same half-widths centred on 8 ns (the datasheet formula, 2 x time accuracy, does not depend on the width). The 33250A pulse width accuracy is not specified in its User's Guide.

sections.title: Test 5: Time interval
sections.setup: Source: pulse generator, both channels 1 Vpp, period 66.6 ns, pulse width 5 ns, Channel 2 delayed 49.9 ns; the two 3.5 mm cables must be exactly the same length.  External 10 MHz reference.  Time Interval 1-2; start and stop slope Positive, auto level Off, level 0 V, noise rejection Off; trigger Manual, 100 readings, delay 0.  53220A and 53230A only.

sections.title: Test 6a: Frequency accuracy, Option 106 microwave channel
sections.setup: Needs Option 106 (6 GHz).  The microwave input is Channel 3 on the 53220A / 53230A and Channel 2 on the 53210A.  Source: 100 MHz and 5.88 GHz at -27 dBm; the input power MUST be -27 +/- 0.5 dBm AT THE COUNTER INPUT (use a cable of known loss, or a power meter).  External 10 MHz reference.  Gate Timed 10 ms, Gate Out On; trigger Manual, 100 readings.

sections.title: Test 6b: Frequency accuracy, Option 115 microwave channel
sections.setup: Needs Option 115 (15 GHz).  Channel 3 (53210A: Channel 2).  Source: 300 MHz at -23 dBm, 3.1 GHz at -27 dBm, 15 GHz at -4 dBm, at the counter input (+/- 0.5 dBm).  External 10 MHz reference.  Gate Timed 10 ms, Gate Out On; trigger Manual, 100 readings.

flags: Printed: the Test 6b setup header says -23 dBm at 300 MHz and the 3.1 GHz step says -27 dBm (15 GHz: -4 dBm); each is used as printed.

sections.title: Test 7: Pulse burst frequency
sections.setup: 53230A only, Option 150 with Option 106 (7a, 7b) or Option 115 (7c, 7d).  Source: pulse-modulated microwave generator (Keysight E8257D-520-UNW), auto-level control Off, PRI 1 ms, burst widths 200 ns / 13 us (6 GHz, 0 dBm) and 400 ns / 13 us (1.35 GHz, -6 dBm).  Freq/Period, Pulse/Burst, Burst Freq; dB level -12 (7a) or -6; Narrow On for the 200 ns and 400 ns bursts, Off for 13 us; Gate Auto On; trigger Manual, 100 readings.  The 96270A has no pulse modulation: another standard is needed.  For Quick verification only 7a and 7c are run.
